title: AI Fundamentals
description: A beginner-friendly introduction to artificial intelligence, how it works and how to use it responsibly.
overview: This course builds practical AI literacy. You will learn what AI systems do, how models learn from data, where common systems can fail, and how to use generated output critically and responsibly. It is designed for learners with no technical background and prepares you for more practical study of machine learning or generative AI.
